set.descent: Rappel south from near the summit to the notch between Middle and South Gunsight, then into the moat at its base.
set.descent_text: From the summit, traverse south along the summit ridge to the south-facing rappel anchors and make two double-rope rappels: the first to the notch between Middle and South Gunsight, the second into the moat at the base of the notch (loose, dirty and cold). With a single 60 m rope expect more rappels. From the glacier, reverse the approach: descend roughly 5,000 ft back to Agnes Creek and hike out 9-10 miles to High Bridge.
